meta.title: Lucho Web | Technical leader who takes AI to production
meta.description: I turn ideas into real products, fast. A technical leader with AI in production: I solve the underlying problem and manage the team, budget and timeline so the product actually ships.

hero.eyebrow: Technical leader · AI in production · {{years}} years building software
hero.title: I turn ideas into real products.
hero.subtitle: I've already shipped AI to production, in front of real users. But AI and code are just my tools. What makes me the right call is getting to the root of the problem and managing the team, budget and timeline so the product actually ships.
hero.imageAlt: Portrait of Lucho, technical and product leader

proof.label: person accountable end to end: idea, team and delivery

shift.title: AI isn't the product. The solved problem is.
shift.intro: Anyone can wire an AI model into an app. The hard part is deciding what to build, what to leave out, and how to reach production with the team and budget you actually have.

value.title: What makes me the right fit
value.subtitle: Four things you'd usually need from different people, in a single accountable lead.

production.title: AI that's already in production
production.desc: I don't talk about AI in theory. I've taken AI-powered solutions to production, with real users, measured costs and results you can review.

speed.title: From idea to product, fast
speed.desc: I cut scope down to what matters, validate early and deliver something usable within weeks. Speed comes from making the right calls, not from rushing.

problems.title: Real problems, not hype-driven tech
problems.desc: I start with the business and the people living the problem. If AI isn't the answer, I'll tell you, and we'll find the one that is.

leadership.title: Teams, budget and timelines
leadership.desc: I build and lead teams, prioritize with judgment, manage the budget and protect deadlines. You always know exactly where the project stands. Certified by Certiprof (SPLPC and SFPC).

process.title: A short, clear path from idea to production
process.subtitle: Every stage ends with something concrete you can see, test or decide on.

steps.title: Understand the problem
steps.desc: I talk to the people who live the problem, define what success looks like and what we won't build.

steps.title: Validate the solution
steps.desc: A working prototype, with AI where it adds value. We decide on evidence before making a big investment.

steps.title: Build and launch
steps.desc: A focused team with short, visible deliveries. We reach production with real users.

steps.title: Measure and improve
steps.desc: We measure against the original goal, tune cost and quality, and keep the product improving.

production.title: A demo impresses. A product in production delivers.
production.subtitle: The gap between an AI experiment and a reliable product lies in everything the demo doesn't show. That's what I take care of.

items.title: Measurable quality
items.desc: Evals and test cases that tell you whether the AI is getting it right, before and after every change.

items.title: Costs under control
items.desc: The right model for each task and usage that's tracked, so the product stays profitable.

items.title: Security and data
items.desc: Protected data, clear permissions and well-defined limits on what the AI is allowed to do.

items.title: Humans in the loop
items.desc: AI assists and automates; critical decisions still have a human owner.

fit.title: We should talk if…
items: You have an idea or a process you want to turn into a product, and you need it shipped soon.
You've already tried AI, but it never made it past the demo or isn't delivering results.
Your team needs someone who connects business, technology and execution.
You need someone accountable for the outcome, not just the code.

contact.title: Got an idea that should already be in production?
contact.subtitle: Tell me about the problem, not the solution. In our first conversation, we'll figure out whether it's worth building and what the first step should be.

call.title: Call
call.desc: To go over your case right now.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.desc: A quick message to get the conversation started.
whatsapp.prefilled: Hi Lucho, I have an idea I'd like to take to production and would love to talk.

email.title: Email
email.desc: If you'd rather share the context in detail.
email.subject: Idea to take to production
email.body:
Hi Lucho,

The problem I want to solve is...

Today we handle it by...

I'd like to have it ready by...

points: I reply within one business day.
Our first conversation is about your problem, not my services.
If it isn't worth building, I'll tell you.

footer.tagline: Ideas turned into real products, with AI in production and one person accountable end to end.
